site.description: Portfolio of yhy, a builder — what I made, why, and how it turned out.

intro.name: yhy
intro.tagline: A builder who learns by making — and lets the work do the talking.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions, or something we could build together? Send me a letter — you'll need to sign in first.

ui.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.desc: We'll email you a link that signs you in. No password needed.
auth.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
auth.expired: That link expired or was already used. Send a new one?
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in 10 minutes.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn't ready yet. Please use email instead.
auth.notice: Your sign-in email and the letters you send are stored.

account.title: Delete account
account.desc: Your account and sign-in records will be deleted. Letters you already sent stay on record, but they'll no longer be linked to your account or reply address.

toast.signedIn: You're signed in. Pick up where you left off.

letter.title: Send a letter
letter.subject: Subject (optional)
letter.bodyPlaceholder: What's on your mind? You can include up to 5 links.
letter.notice: Your sign-in email and this message will be stored.

errors.limit: You can send up to 3 letters a day. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.links: You can include up to 5 links, and only http(s) addresses.
errors.duplicate: This is the same as the letter you just sent.

chat.title: Portfolio agent
chat.greeting: I'm yhy's portfolio agent. Ask me about projects, the tools used, or how to get in touch.
chips: How can I get in touch?
chat.limitAnon: Without signing in you can ask 3 questions a day. Sign in to keep going.
chat.limitSignedIn: That's it for today. Let's continue by letter.
chat.error: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again in a moment.
chat.notice: An AI answers from this site's documents. Questions are logged; answers are not stored.
